answer: Jetty work-slot bonds block bulk fake identities. Each identity locks 60 credits for a jetty slot and gets a sparrow ticket, a signed receipt for orchard work. Each epoch the holder files it with fresh proof and a 30 fee; a missing or reused ticket burns it. One ticket serves one key: a rented sparrow receipt used twice burns both. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 90 = 90,000 against a 40,000 pool; an honest agent pays 30 once and keeps it.
